title: Yate (YATE) Lists on Hotcoin, Linking AI Coordination Utility Layer with On-Chain Ecosystems-Unsee News-A boutique key news website integrating authority, practicality and immediacy
text:
As artificial intelligence and Web3 technologies continue to converge, connecting AI models and intelligent agents with on-chain settlement is becoming a growing industry focus. Through a modular architecture, Yate is exploring an AI coordination utility layer designed to support the invocation, composition, and verification of AI services, as well as on-chain payments for those services.
　
Yate’s native token, YATE, is deployed on BNB Smart Chain with a total supply of 2 billion tokens. Positioned around an AI-focused digital ecosystem, the project seeks to balance performance with on-chain verifiability while supporting a range of AI applications, including AI assistants, content generation, automated workflows, and developer agents.
　
According to our research, Hotcoin, with nine years of experience in digital asset trading, remains committed to providing global users with access to quality digital assets and trading services. YATE/USDT will make its global debut on Hotcoin at 12:00 on September 3, 2026 (UTC+8). Deposits will open at 12:00 on September 3, 2026 (UTC+8), while withdrawals will open at 12:00 on September 4, 2026 (UTC+8).
　
With its listing on Hotcoin, YATE will gain an additional trading venue and broader market exposure, while giving more users the opportunity to learn about Yate and its positioning within the AI digital ecosystem. Its future development will depend on demand for AI services, product execution, market participation, and continued ecosystem development.
